items.title: Qilin claims Japanese professional video and imaging electronics manufacturer
items.summary: CYFIRMA's 1 October weekly report observed Qilin listing a Japanese electronics manufacturer specialising in professional video and imaging technology on its dark-web leak site.

items.title: The Gentlemen ransomware lists a Thailand-based company
items.summary: The same CYFIRMA report records a Thai company posted to The Gentlemen ransomware group's data leak site as a new compromise.

items.title: Cl0p Oracle E-Business Suite extortion campaign: Harvard, Envoy Air, Washington Post among victims
items.summary: Cl0p's exploitation of an Oracle E-Business Suite zero-day between July and October is reported to have hit nearly 30 major organisations, including Harvard University, American Airlines subsidiary Envoy Air and the Washington Post.

items.title: Ransomware data theft up 275% in 2026, led by schools, hospitals and government
items.summary: An October analysis reports ransomware-linked data theft surged 275% in 2026, with schools, hospitals and government agencies accounting for some of the largest claims.

items.title: Black Kite 2026 Ransomware Report: 7,551 victims, up 24.9%
items.summary: Black Kite's annual report counts 7,551 publicly listed ransomware victims, a 24.9% year-over-year increase.

ransomware.note: Few individually named victims surfaced in the first days of October; the two leak-site claims are reported by CYFIRMA without company names.

items.title: Azure: two incidents hit 18 regions in 40 hours (Sep 29 - Oct 1)
items.summary: Two separate Azure outages took gateway services offline across 18 regions, producing an 8-hour-24-minute global disruption affecting Azure AD B2C, Azure Portal, SQL Database, Databricks, Healthcare APIs and Static Web Apps.

items.title: Azure OpenAI in Sweden: failed API calls for nearly six hours
items.summary: As part of the same Azure incident window, Azure OpenAI customers in the Sweden region experienced failed API calls for close to six hours.

items.title: Cloudflare, Twilio and Zoom reporting problems on outage tracker
items.summary: An October outage tracker shows three services reporting problems - Cloudflare, Twilio and Zoom - while AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and GitHub report normal operation.

items.title: Forrester: expect at least two major multi-day hyperscaler outages in 2026
items.summary: Forrester predicts at least two major multi-day outages at AWS, Azure or Google Cloud in 2026 as providers prioritise AI infrastructure over ageing legacy systems.

outage.note: No major AWS or Google Cloud incident found so far in October; the tracker status is a point-in-time snapshot.

items.title: Fortinet FortiMail zero-day (CVE-2026-104286) exploited, added to CISA KEV
items.summary: CISA added a CVSS 9.8 FortiMail flaw allowing unauthenticated arbitrary file writes to the KEV catalog after active exploitation, with a federal remediation deadline of 4 October 2026.

items.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager auth bypass (CVE-2026-76504) added to CISA KEV
items.summary: A CVSS 9.8 authentication bypass letting an unauthenticated remote attacker gain admin-level access to Catalyst SD-WAN Manager was added to KEV following reports of active exploitation.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway zero-days (CVE-2026-88771, CVE-2026-88772) exploited
items.summary: CISA's 27 September alert added two critical NetScaler ADC/Gateway zero-days to KEV, each independently enabling remote code execution.

items.title: CISA adds one known exploited vulnerability to catalog (1 October)
items.summary: CISA published a 1 October alert adding one new vulnerability to the KEV catalog on evidence of active exploitation.

items.title: Texas and southern Oklahoma: flash-flood threat from remnants of Hurricane Polo
items.summary: Remnants of Hurricane Polo put swaths of Texas and southern Oklahoma under a moderate (Level 3 of 4) risk of flash flooding and excessive rainfall, with the threat extending into the Corn Belt.

items.title: Atlantic enters October with no hurricane - a first in the satellite era
items.summary: Eight Atlantic storms have been named in 2026 but none has reached hurricane strength, extending the basin's hurricane drought beyond 11 months as forecasters watch whether October ends the pause.

items.title: M 4.7 earthquake - 5 km NNE of Korumburra, Australia (Oct 02)
items.summary: USGS-listed significant earthquake in Victoria, Australia on 2 October; PAGER alert green, no tsunami.

items.title: M 4.2 earthquake - 6 km WNW of Wauna, Washington (Sep 29)
items.summary: USGS-listed significant earthquake in the Puget Sound area on 29 September; PAGER alert green, no tsunami.

physical.note: No major wildfire or typhoon event surfaced for early October.
